methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
A textile wet processing plant was chosen as a case study for 
illustrating the effectiveness of the framework using multiple regression method.

paper_type.evidence_quote:
The authors also conducted a survey in fifteen textile wet processing plants to assess 
the prevailing energy monitoring practices.

stage1.notes: Textile wet processing is not in the closed Level 3B sector list; the paper also evaluates one plant and surveys 15 plants.

multi_site.evidence_quote:

The program-wise quantity 
of fabric to be processed would be multiplied with the respective energy 
factors of each program to derive the program-wise equivalent production. 
The sum total of the program-wise equivalent production figures for any 
day would be the “Equivalent production” of the day
